tagline: Pledge an empire, master the forge, and hunt the monsters of myth.
description:
## Choose Your Empire

Three city-states stand upon the shores of Hellas — **Sparta** of unbreakable bronze, **Athens** of wisdom and storm-touched insight, and **Corinth** of golden ships and endless trade. Pledge your oath to one, and its blessing follows you into every battle.

## Walk Your Path

Take up the spear and shield of the **Hoplite**, the horn bow of the **Toxotes**, or the lightning-wreathed staff of the **Magos**. Each path carries its own god-given art — a sweeping phalanx strike, a fan of arrows, or a thunderbolt called straight from Olympus.

## The Great Gamble

In the city plaza, Brontes the Smith will temper your weapon from **+0 to +9**. Every hammer-blow is a wager: success makes you mighty, failure can dull your blade — or shatter it outright. This is the grind that made classic online worlds addictive, and it is beating at the heart of this one.

## Hunt the Myths

Wolves and boars roam the lowlands. Satyrs and harpies hold the rocky slopes. Centaurs and gorgons stalk the deep wilds, and in a ruined arena beyond the city gate, the **Minotaur** waits. Follow Priestess Melite's Five Trials, shatter the cursed Oracle Stones, join a war-clan, and carve your name into legend.
